license_required.quote: Any person who uses in any sign or in any advertisement or otherwise, the word or words "doctor of podiatric medicine," "doctor of podiatry," "podiatric doctor," "podiatric surgeon," "D.P.M.," "podiatrist," "foot specialist," or any other term or terms or any letters indicating or implying that they are a doctor of podiatric medicine, or that they practice podiatric medicine, or hold themselves out as practicing podiatric medicine or foot correction as defined in Section 2472, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as provided for in this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine from an approved college or school of podiatric medicine
degree_required.quote: Each applicant for a certificate to practice podiatric medicine shall show by an official transcript or other official evidence satisfactory to the board that is submitted directly to the board by the academic institution that he or she has successfully completed a medical curriculum extending over a period of at least four academic years, or 32 months of actual instruction, in a college or school of podiatric medicine approved by the board.

accrediting_body.quote: a college or school of podiatric medicine approved by the board

credential_pegged.quote: the applicant, within the past 10 years, has passed parts I, II, and III of the examination administered by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners of the United States

required.quote: before a certificate to practice podiatric medicine may be issued, each applicant shall show by evidence satisfactory to the board, submitted directly to the board by the sponsoring institution, that he or she has satisfactorily completed at least two years of postgraduate podiatric medical and podiatric surgical training in a general acute care hospital approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education.

experience_source.quote: before a certificate to practice podiatric medicine may be issued, each applicant shall show by evidence satisfactory to the board, submitted directly to the board by the sponsoring institution, that he or she has satisfactorily completed at least two years of postgraduate podiatric medical and podiatric surgical training in a general acute care hospital approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education.

exams.notes: May be required of all applicants by the board to ascertain clinical competence
exams.quote: The applicant has passed within the past 10 years any oral and practical examination that may be required of all applicants by the board to ascertain clinical competence.

interval_years.quote: Certificates to practice podiatric medicine shall expire at midnight on the last day of the birth month of the licensee during the second year of a two-year term.

required.quote: In order to ensure the continuing competence of persons licensed to practice podiatric medicine, the board shall adopt and administer regulations requiring continuing education of those licensees.

available.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine by credentialing if the applicant has submitted directly to the board from the credentialing organizations verification that they are licensed as a doctor of podiatric medicine in any other state

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed as a DPM in another state, graduated from an approved school, passed NBPME Part III or equivalent, completed CPME-approved postgraduate training, passed any required oral/practical exam, have no disciplinary history, and submit a disciplinary databank report from the Federation of Podiatric Medical Boards.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine by credentialing if the applicant has submitted directly to the board from the credentialing organizations verification that they are licensed as a doctor of podiatric medicine in any other state and meets all of the following requirements

exists.quote: There is created in the Department of Consumer Affairs the Podiatric Medical Board of California.

national_certification.quote: has passed parts I, II, and III of the examination administered by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners of the United States

national_association.quote: postgraduate podiatric medical and podiatric surgical training in a general acute care hospital approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

regulatory_model.quote: without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as provided for in this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to practice podiatric medicine to each applicant who meets the requirements of this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as provided for in this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

title_protection.quote: Any person who uses in any sign or in any advertisement or otherwise, the word or words "doctor of podiatric medicine," "doctor of podiatry," "podiatric doctor," "podiatric surgeon," "D.P.M.," "podiatrist," "foot specialist," or any other term or terms or any letters indicating or implying that they are a doctor of podiatric medicine, or that they practice podiatric medicine, or hold themselves out as practicing podiatric medicine or foot correction as defined in Section 2472, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as provided for in this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: Unless otherwise provided by law, no postgraduate trainee, intern, resident postdoctoral fellow, or instructor may engage in the practice of podiatric medicine, or receive compensation therefor, or offer to engage in the practice of podiatric medicine unless he or she holds a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate to practice podiatric medicine issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this chapter or committing any act of unprofessional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may order the denial of an application for, or the suspension of, or the revocation of, or the imposition of probationary conditions upon, a certificate to practice podiatric medicine for any of the causes set forth in Article 12 (commencing with Section 2220) in accordance with Section 2222.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unprofessional conduct includes, but is not limited to, the following: (b) Gross negligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated negligent acts involving two or more negligent acts or omissions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated negligent acts. To be repeated, there must be two or more negligent acts or omissions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: unprofessional conduct includes, but is not limited to, the following: (d) Incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act involving dishonesty or corruption substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a podiatric physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any act involving dishonesty or corruption that is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a physician and surgeon.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any action or conduct that would have warranted denial of certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any action or conduct that would have warranted the denial of a certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure without good cause to attend and participate in a board interview within 30 days of notification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure by a certificate holder, in the absence of good cause, to attend and participate in an interview by the board no later than 30 calendar days after being notified by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Action intended to cause patient to rescind consent to release medical records to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any action of the licensee, or another person acting on behalf of the licensee, intended to cause their patient or their patient's authorized representative to rescind consent to release the patient's medical records to the board or the Department of Consumer Affairs, Health Quality Investigation Unit.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dissuading, intimidating, or tampering with a patient, witness, or any person to prevent reporting or testifying
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dissuading, intimidating, or tampering with a patient, witness, or any person in an attempt to prevent them from reporting or testifying about a licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a podiatric physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a physician and surgeon constitutes unprofessional conduct within the meaning of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violating federal or state statutes regulating dangerous drugs or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of a charge of violating any federal statutes or regulations or any statute or regulation of this state, regulating dangerous drugs or controlled substances, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substances or alcohol to the extent that it impairs ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use or prescribing for or administering to himself or herself, of any controlled substance; or the use of any of the dangerous drugs specified in Section 4022, or of alcoholic beverages, to the extent, or in such a manner as to be dangerous or injurious to the licensee, or to any other person or to the public, or to the extent that such use impairs the ability of the licensee to practice medicine safely

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing dangerous drugs without an appropriate prior examination and medical indication
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing dangerous drugs as defined in Section 4022 without an appropriate prior examination and a medical indication, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making or signing a certificate or document related to the practice of podiatry which falsely represents facts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making or signing any certificate or other document directly or indirectly related to the practice of medicine or podiatry which falsely represents the existence or nonexistence of a state of facts, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Altering or creating false medical records with fraudulent intent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Altering or modifying the medical record of any person, with fraudulent intent, or creating any false medical record, with fraudulent intent, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful, unauthorized violation of professional confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The willful, unauthorized violation of professional confidence constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, aiding, or abetting any unlicensed or suspended person to engage in the practice of medicine or podiatric medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The employing, directly or indirectly, the aiding, or the abetting of any unlicensed person or any suspended, revoked, or unlicensed practitioner to engage in the practice of medicine or any other mode of treating the sick or afflicted which requires a license to practice constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain adequate and accurate records for at least seven years after the last date of service
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure of a physician and surgeon to maintain adequate and accurate records relating to the provision of services to their patients for at least seven years after the last date of service to a patient constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in violation of Section 17500 (false or misleading advertising)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any advertising in violation of Section 17500, relating to false or misleading advertising, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating another licensed practitioner or permitting use of one's certificate by another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The impersonation of another licensed practitioner or permitting or allowing another person to use his or her certificate to engage in the practice of medicine or podiatric medicine constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to inform patient and obtain consent before delivering healthcare via telehealth
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure of a health care provider to comply with this section shall constitute unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine while under the influence of narcotic drugs or alcohol to the extent of impairing safe practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No licensee shall practice medicine while under the influence of any narcotic drug or alcohol to such an extent as to impair his or her ability to conduct the practice of medicine with safety to the public and his or her patients. Violation of this section constitutes unprofessional conduct and is a misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other discipline imposed by another state or federal agency that would be grounds for discipline in California
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation, suspension, or other discipline, restriction, or limitation imposed by another state upon a license or certificate to practice medicine issued by that state, or the revocation, suspension, or restriction of the authority to practice medicine by any agency of the federal government, that would have been grounds for discipline in California of a licensee under this chapter, shall constitute grounds for disciplinary action for unprofessional conduct against the licensee in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to produce requested documents within the required deadline
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to produce requested documents or copies thereof, after being informed of the required deadline, shall constitute unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to comply with a court order mandating release of records to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A failure or refusal of a licensee to comply with a court order, issued in the enforcement of a subpoena, mandating the release of records to the board constitutes unprofessional conduct and is grounds for suspension or revocation of their license.

definition_quote.value: podiatric medicine means the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot and the nonsurgical treatment of the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot.
definition_quote.quote: "podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot and the nonsurgical treatment of the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot.

value: nonsurgical treatment of muscles and tendons of the leg
wound care treatment on the leg no further proximal than tibial tubercle
methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, and electrical treatment of the human foot, including the ankle and tendons that insert into the foot and the nonsurgical treatment of the muscles and tendons of the leg governing the functions of the foot

drug_authority.value: A doctor of podiatric medicine may prescribe and administer local anesthesia; may prescribe and administer influenza and COVID-19 vaccines to persons three years of age or older. General or other anesthesia must be administered by another licensed health care practitioner authorized to do so.
drug_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine shall not administer an anesthetic other than local. If an anesthetic other than local is required for any procedure, the anesthetic shall be administered by another licensed health care practitioner who is authorized to administer the required anesthetic within the scope of their practice.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: a doctor of podiatric medicine with training or experience in wound care may treat ulcers resulting from local and systemic etiologies on the leg no further proximal than the tibial tubercle.

amputation_authorized.quote: Perform a partial amputation of the foot no further proximal than the Chopart's joint.

anesthesia_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine shall not administer an anesthetic other than local. If an anesthetic other than local is required for any procedure, the anesthetic shall be administered by another licensed health care practitioner who is authorized to administer the required anesthetic within the scope of their practice.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: Perform surgical treatment of the ankle and tendons at the level of the ankle pursuant to subdivision (e).

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine may perform surgical treatment of the ankle and tendons at the level of the ankle only in the following locations: (1) A licensed general acute care hospital... (2) A licensed surgical clinic... (3) An ambulatory surgical center that is certified to participate in the Medicare Program

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: a doctor of podiatric medicine with training or experience in wound care may treat ulcers resulting from local and systemic etiologies on the leg no further proximal than the tibial tubercle.

board_certification_body.quote: Is approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education.

telehealth_authorized.quote: An appropriate prior examination does not require a synchronous interaction between the patient and the licensee and can be achieved through the use of telehealth, including, but not limited to, a self-screening tool or a questionnaire, provided that the licensee complies with the appropriate standard of care.

wound_debridement_authorized.quote: a doctor of podiatric medicine with training or experience in wound care may treat ulcers resulting from local and systemic etiologies on the leg no further proximal than the tibial tubercle.

vaccination_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine may independently prescribe and administer influenza and COVID-19 vaccines, consistent with recommendations adopted pursuant to Section 120164 of the Health and Safety Code, to persons three years of age or older.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this chapter prohibits the manufacture, the recommendation, or the sale of either corrective shoes or appliances for the human feet.

assistant_surgeon_role_authorized.quote: Perform services under the direct supervision of a physician and surgeon, as an assistant at surgery, in surgical procedures that are otherwise beyond the scope of practice of a doctor of podiatric medicine.

office_based_surgery_accreditation_requi.quote: An outpatient setting accredited pursuant to subdivision (g) of Section 1248.1 of the Health and Safety Code.
